value.rationale: Recent experiments established programmable scalar harmonic switching as a one-bath nonequilibrium platform. The rigorous question of extracting planar directed area transport from two individually reversible conservative traps is physically natural. The exact symmetry criterion, unexpected suppression of linear coupling response, and unique rate optimum in an explicit nondegenerate trap are useful quantitative design boundaries beyond a routine moment formula.
